domainDescription: Japanese used in YouTube subtitles across everyday media categories; this is media frequency, not universal Japanese frequency.

license.attribution: TUBELEX Japanese frequency lists by Adam Nohejl and contributors

readingSource.policy: A row FrequencyPackMappingV1 matches but can't place on one entry gets its UniDic lemma reading (lForm) when UniDic gives that lemma and part of speech exactly one; FrequencyPackMappingV2 then requires the reading. The reading is withdrawn when it would move an entry V1 already ranks to a worse-ranked row. Other rows carry no reading and map as in V1.

rankTiePolicy: One-based source row ordinal after the header; equal counts retain pinned source artifact order and receive distinct ranks.
